answer: A concrete Sybil defence is per-identity bonded stake slashed on proven duplicate identity. Each agent locks a bond worth more than the total reward one identity can earn in a window, and payouts are capped per identity. An attacker running a herd must lock that bond for every clone, so cost grows linearly while reward stays flat. Detection need not be a fable: attesters can challenge a suspected duplicate and the loser forfeits the bond. The ferrous part is capital sitting idle and exposed for the whole attack. A sonnet of praise cannot replace that cost.
